title: cocode.export (event)
description: Send to Claude: a handoff. The engine saves it as a session and closes the window. Also the shape of the cocode.snapshot reply, which is the same payload without intent: that is why intent is optional here (always present on cocode.export, absent on the snapshot). The engine may add a session id.

session.description: The saved session's id. Added by the engine when it stores the handoff; not sent by the page.

label.description: The first non-empty line (at most 60 characters) plus the language, e.g. "for each user in users · pseudo". The saved session's summary.

intent.description: What the human picked in the select: auto means you decide. Present on cocode.export, absent on the cocode.snapshot reply.

truncated.description: true when text was longer than 64 000 characters; the tail is kept.

selection.description: The selected range, when there is one.

runs.description: At most the last 3 runs, newest last, with output tails of at most 2 000 characters.

stats.description: Ghost feedback so far in this window.

acceptedLocal.description: Of the accepted ones, how many came from the local predictor.

rev.description: Document revision; starts at 1 and never goes down.

lang.description: Free text, 1-24 characters: python, js, my-lang, pseudo.

col.description: 0-based column, in characters of the line.

build.description: The latest build, stale or not (build.rev < rev means stale).

code.description: The real program. May be empty while status is building or failed.

at.description: Epoch milliseconds when the build arrived.

id.description: r_<rev>_<n>, or an id Claude made up.

buildRev.description: The build rev that ran; null when it ran without one.

at.description: Epoch milliseconds when the run started.

ms.description: Duration; null until the run is closed.

exit.description: Exit code; null until the run is closed.
